Re-run a selection on new data

reselect.Rd

Re-does the selection, possibly on new data, with the same settings as the original. The pre-processing is not re-estimated: the original recipe from selector_obj (including its centering and scaling) is applied to newdata. This is what infer_boot() calls on each resample.

Usage

reselect(selector_obj, newdata)

Arguments

selector_obj

a selector

newdata

a data frame (or the same one)

Value

a new selector
